The sessions command allows the user to run multiple Stata sessions. 

This is currently a test version of `sessions`.
More dertail will be added to this page (hopefully) soon.

> **Installation**

`. net install sessions, from(https://www.pclambert.net/downloads/sessions)`

A simple example shown at the Northern European Stata Conference can be downloaded [here](https://www.pclambert.net/downloads/sessions_example.zip).
